data.one_liner: Flutter plugin wrapping the Insider mobile SDK for user tracking and push notifications.
data.what_it_does: Wraps the native Insider SDK on Android and iOS to provide user tracking, custom event tagging, push notifications, smart recommendations, App Cards, and content optimization through a unified Dart API.
use_when: You need to integrate the Insider growth and marketing platform into your Flutter application.
Your application requires features like push notifications, user identification, smart recommendations, and App Cards provided by Insider.
avoid_when: You are looking for a standalone notification or analytics provider without the Insider ecosystem.
You want a pure Dart implementation without native SDK wrappers.
strengths: Unified Dart API wrapping native Android and iOS Insider SDKs.
Supports a wide range of growth features including push notifications, App Cards, and smart recommendations.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific setup on Android and iOS, including native SDK configuration.
Tied directly to the commercial Insider platform.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the package to pubspec.yaml, initializing with partner credentials, and platform-specific configurations for Android and iOS (such as CocoaPods or Swift Package Manager for iOS).

alternatives.name: onesignal_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick OneSignal if you need a dedicated push notification and messaging platform rather than Insider's full growth suite.

alternatives.name: firebase_messaging
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick Firebase Messaging if you want a direct, native Firebase push integration without commercial marketing platforms.
